delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile approach characterized by short, time-boxed development cycles with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative process allows for incremental releases and adaptive planning to meet evolving requirements.

AI tools assist in drafting documentation, code generation, and testing, while human experts review, integrate, and approve all outputs to ensure quality and alignment with client expectations. Scope changes are managed through controlled processes, and quality practices are embedded throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure a reliable and user-friendly system.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to implement a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to streamline HR operations and enhance management oversight. This system aims to improve data accuracy, reporting capabilities, and employee self-service functionalities, thereby supporting the company's strategic HR objectives and operational efficiency.

Exist Software Labs proposes a tailored HRIS solution that integrates key HR functions into a unified platform. The project will be delivered using an AI-enabled agile methodology, ensuring iterative development with continuous client feedback and quality assurance. Upon completion, Kalinaw Trading Corporation will have a robust, cloud-deployed HRIS that supports efficient HR management and employee engagement.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution consolidates essential HR capabilities including employee information management, leave and attendance tracking, payroll interfacing, and comprehensive reporting. It empowers HR staff with tools to maintain employee records, manage employment movements, and generate standard reports, while providing employees with self-service access to personal data, leave balances, and payslips. The system supports the company's organizational structure and enforces role-based access control to ensure data security.

This solution aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation's operational workflows by facilitating online leave applications and approvals, attendance corrections, and document management. Integration with existing payroll systems ensures seamless data exchange, while audit trails and notifications enhance transparency and compliance. The approach focuses on usability and scalability to meet current and future HR needs.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is designed as a cloud-deployed microservices architecture utilizing Java and Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend interface, and PostgreSQL as the primary data store. This layered architecture separates presentation, business logic, and data management, promoting scalability and maintainability.

Integration with external payroll systems is handled through secure, well-defined interfaces, while the system supports multiple environments including development, test (UAT), and production. Security is enforced through role-based access control and comprehensive audit logging. The architecture supports high availability and performance targets suitable for up to 300 concurrent users with fast response times.
warranty_support: The warranty period covers defect correction and system performance issues identified after deployment, ensuring the HRIS operates as specified. Defects can be reported through a defined process and will be addressed promptly within the warranty timeframe.

The warranty excludes enhancements or changes beyond the agreed scope, which can be addressed through separate support agreements. This approach provides Kalinaw Trading Corporation with confidence in system stability and access to ongoing assistance as needed.
